# nososim

Simulate hospital outbreaks with changing patient populations, contact patterns,
and interventions.

Create a daily population, simulate transmission, and visualise who infected whom.

## Installation

Install the development version from GitHub:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("CyGei/nososim")
```

## A first outbreak

Simulate an outbreak in a population of 30 people, starting with one infection. 
Containment strategy starts on day 10 reducing transmission hazards by 50%.

```{r first-outbreak}
library(nososim)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)
dates <- as.Date("2026-01-01") + 0:20

timeline <- make_timeline(n = 30, dates = dates, admission_delay = 0:4, R = 2)
imported <- data.frame(id = "ID_1", date = dates[1])

outbreak <- make_outbreak(
  timeline,
  imported,
  w = dpois(0:10, 2),
  dates = dates,
  intervention = function(present, date) {
    E_t <- matrix(
      0,
      nrow(present),
      nrow(present),
      dimnames = list(present$id, present$id)
    )
    if (date >= dates[10]) {
      E_t[,] <- 0.5
    }
    E_t
  }
)

autoplot(outbreak, aes(colour = I("#B8D8D3"), fill = I("#176B65")))
```
